article.title: Сальмонелла в сухой смеси для кекса: от одной упаковки к расследованию вспышки
article.scope: Полный перевод основной статьи на 2 журнальных страницах: весь текст расследования, сведения об авторах и организациях, заявление о конфликте интересов и обе сноски. Все 4 библиографические записи сохранены на языке оригинала. В источнике нет отдельных аннотации, рисунков и таблиц. Текст подготовлен по полному XML PMC и сверён с PDF издателя. Подзаголовки добавлены для навигации; редакционные пояснения отделены от перевода.

source.license: Public domain under article-specific PMC XML statement and MMWR reuse policy
source.rights_note: Primary article-specific statement takes precedence over Europe PMC CC BY shorthand. CDC attribution, free-source link and nonendorsement notice supplied; source content preserved; no CDC logo introduced.

selection.reader: Quality, food safety, technology and laboratory staff at dry-mix manufacturers
selection.utility: A positive unopened retail package and genome/exposure evidence alongside negative later factory samples; distinguishes separate evidence streams and avoids inferring a contaminated ingredient.
selection.source_probe: Complete 2-page PDF and XML reviewed after two more complex candidates were held for data inconsistencies.
selection.limits: Historical outbreak concluded January 2019; 43 boxes not a market prevalence sample; no universal SNP cutoff; original Oregon patients not asserted to be among seven final cases.
selection.semantic_ranking: No new TypeSafe call: single short candidate selected and reviewed in full, not a batch of repeated semantic decisions.

review.spelled_numbers: Manually compared: two patients, six outlets, four patients / SNPs, one SNP, seven final cases in five states.
review.pdf_visual_review: Readable four-page packet; full source body and reference text retained; editorial notes distinct.
